data.title: AS-75 F2: .dockerignore determines build context but sits outside IMAGE_INPUTS and its COPY-set guard

data.to:
From the AS-75 QA review (qa-ruben), finding F2. apps/chat/.dockerignore is tracked in git and determines what the build context contains, so a committed edit to it changes the resulting image. It sits OUTSIDE IMAGE_INPUTS (the 9 paths whose git digest drives the deploy predicate) and outside the COPY-set guard that keeps IMAGE_INPUTS honest — the guard derives its expected set from the Dockerfile's COPY lines, and .dockerignore appears in none of them, so it is invisible to the check by construction.

Consequence: edit .dockerignore, merge, and the watcher will never rebuild. The image silently diverges from master exactly the way AS-75 exists to prevent. Latent today because nothing has edited it, which is also why nobody would notice.

ACCEPTANCE. The deploy predicate accounts for .dockerignore (and any other tracked file that alters build context without appearing in a COPY line), with the guard extended so the omission is caught rather than assumed. Prove it: commit a change to .dockerignore and observe the predicate go dirty.

data.body: Plan written (.lattice/plans/task_01M1SJDVMGSTT8GAW09ETXNNE3.md). Verified F2 against master cef63a8: .dockerignore is outside IMAGE_INPUTS and invisible to the COPY-set guard by construction; today it is inert for image content (it excludes nothing under a COPY source), so the hazard is a future edit. Honest enumeration of context-shaping files not COPY'd: exactly one (.dockerignore); compose.override.*, Dockerfile.dockerignore, apps/chat/.env do not exist, and the base-image tag is out of git's sight (parked, plan §9). Approach: COPY .dockerignore into the image as data next to compose.yaml/Dockerfile (drop its self-exclusion), so IMAGE_INPUTS grows to 10 and the existing equality guard REQUIRES it; plus a second expected-set source — a pure classifyImagePaths over git ls-files (every tracked path is an image input or declared NOT_IMAGE_INPUTS, strays fail by name), a strict .dockerignore parser, and the acceptance recipe as a real-git scratch-repo test with a README-only negative control (host-only; counted skip of 2 in the git-less compose runner). M4 mutants M1–M4 with exact red sets in §6. Baseline host 498/498 skipped 0; predicted 504/504 host, 504 with skipped 2 compose. Merge consequence stated (§5): the id scheme changes, so the merge triggers two rebuilds, once. Seam (§8): disjoint regions of advance-watcher.mjs and watcher.test.js from AS-84; recommended merge order AS-85 -> AS-86 -> AS-84 -> AS-87 -> AS-88. Implementer developer-lena, reviewer qa-priya (Ruben authored the finding; Priya reads the enumeration cold; Ruben to AS-84's seam). Branch feat/AS-86-dockerignore-image-input.

Staffing call (Owen, tick watcher:93997 loop tick 23): AS-86 runs as the third lane on Lena, concurrently with her AS-85 lane, per plan §10 — AS-85 is test-mostly and small, and putting AS-86 on Marcus would have him holding two branches on advance-watcher.mjs at once, which §10 explicitly avoids. Separate worktree (.worktrees/AS-86) and separate scratchpad subdirectory (scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-86/).

AS-86 implementation report (developer-lena, tick watcher:93997 loop tick 23). Branch `feat/AS-86-dockerignore-image-input`, commits **735b050** (manifests + watcher exports) and **b4d3455** (guards + docs). Working tree clean; nothing outside `apps/chat` touched; `.worktrees/AS-84` and `.worktrees/AS-85` untouched.

## Findings first (5, all outside the criteria list; 0 blocking)

**F-1 — plan errata, affects criterion 3.** The predicted M1 red set of four is too narrow, because master already hard-codes the input count in places plan §4 does not name, and AS-86 must move them: `watcher.test.js`'s `AS-75 parseLsTree` test asserts `full.length` / `ok.count` / `r.expected` as literal `9` (lines 636/641/649, plus the "8 of 9" prose), and the deploy-ops short-set test asserts the log text `/8 of 9 image inputs/` (line 1007). Both are now `10` and `9 of 10`. I kept them as literals rather than deriving them from `IMAGE_INPUTS.length` — the file's own cardinality-first style, and deriving them would make the guard follow the mutant. Consequence: the **observed M1 red set is 8 tests, not 4**. All four extras are genuine guards over the same fact; enumerated below.

**F-2 — plan errata, affects criterion 9.** §6 predicts compose `skipped 2`. Three tests skip when git is absent, not two: the two in `deploy-inputs-git.test.js` **plus** `deploy-shape: every tracked path under apps/chat is an image input or declared not one`, which uses the same git-runnable predicate. The container number to expect is **504 total, skipped 3**.

**F-3 — stale comment, deliberately left.** `advance-watcher.mjs:358` (the `parseLsTree` docstring) still reads "A digest over 8 of 9 inputs would be stable, wrong…". Criterion 11 forbids touching anything else in that file, so it stands. Candidate as a one-line rider on AS-87, which edits that file anyway.

**F-4 — guard scope, worth knowing before anyone trusts it.** The index-backed `deploy-shape` guard **cannot detect M2 today**: the live repo has zero unclassified paths, so a classifier that mislabels strays still passes it against an empty set. The two tests that do kill M2 are the pure fixture test and the scratch-repo stray test, both of which supply a stray. The index guard is a regression net for a *future* stray, not a live falsifier of the classifier.

**F-5 — probe, under the survivor-is-a-lead rule.** My first falsifier for criterion 8 (add `README.md` to `IMAGE_INPUTS`) died **earlier than intended**, at the 10-stub assertion in the test helper, and therefore proved nothing about the negative control. I re-read the mutated diff, re-aimed at a cardinality-preserving mutation (inside `makeDeployOps`, digest `apps/chat/README.md` in place of `apps/chat/Dockerfile`), and it reds at `deploy-inputs-git.test.js:164` — the control's own assertion — with the id moving `c9ea7a8d55e4726e` → `9466eda1e3651d35`. The negative control is discriminating.

## Mutant red sets

Method for every mutant: back up, apply, **assert the mutation applied at the named site** (function-anchored match + file-wide uniqueness check + reported line number), run the **full** host suite, restore, prove the tree with `git diff --exit-code`, re-run green. This shell rejects `trap`, so the restore is a node `finally` block; every run below reported tree-clean and 504/504 after restore. Harness kept at `scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-86/`.

**M1 — remove `'.dockerignore'` from `IMAGE_INPUTS`.** Applied at the frozen array, line 117, entries 10 → 9 (asserted). `504 tests / 496 pass / 8 fail / 0 skipped`. Red set (8; plan predicted 4 — see F-1):

1. `deploy-shape: IMAGE_INPUTS is exactly the set the Dockerfile COPYs`
2. `deploy-shape: .dockerignore is an image input and hides no manifest`
3. `deploy-shape: every tracked path under apps/chat is an image input or declared not one`
4. `AS-86 deploy-inputs-git: a committed change to .dockerignore changes the desired id`

— the four the plan named — plus

5. `AS-75 parseLsTree: a short input set is a refusal, and the digest ignores git output order` (the literal 10)
6. `AS-86 classifyImagePaths: strays are named, roots cover their children, and names are not prefixes` (fixture expects `.dockerignore` among inputs)
7. `AS-75 makeDeployOps: a dirty image-input tree refuses, and a broken git refuses differently` (the "9 of 10 image inputs" log literal)
8. `AS-86 deploy-inputs-git: a stray compose.override.yaml is rejected by the classifier` (the 10-stub assertion in the scratch-repo helper)

**M2 — `classifyImagePaths` swallows strays** (unknowns pushed to `declared`). Applied **inside** `classifyImagePaths`, function at line 150, target line 158, uniqueness checked file-wide. `504 / 502 pass / 2 fail / 0 skipped`. Red set (2) — **exactly as predicted**:

1. `AS-86 classifyImagePaths: strays are named, roots cover their children, and names are not prefixes`
2. `AS-86 deploy-inputs-git: a stray compose.override.yaml is rejected by the classifier`

**M3 — digest a short set** (`IMAGE_INPUTS.slice(0, 9)`). Applied at the `const paths =` line 774, inside `makeDeployOps` (line 741), checked not to occur earlier in the file. `504 / 503 pass / 1 fail / 0 skipped`. Red set (1) — **exactly as predicted**:

1. `AS-86 deploy-inputs-git: a committed change to .dockerignore changes the desired id`

Confirmed from the assertion text that the AS-75 refusal is what catches it: *"a clean stub repo digests: reason inputs-missing"*, `desired === null`, at step 2 — the cardinality refusal fires before any digest is taken.

**M4 — `.dockerignore` hides an image input** (line `test/fixtures` inserted after `chat`; presence re-asserted by regex after the write). `504 / 503 pass / 1 fail / 0 skipped`. Red set (1) — **exactly as predicted**:

1. `deploy-shape: .dockerignore is an image input and hides no manifest`

**M7 (criterion 7's falsifier, mine) — `parseDockerignore` shrugs at globs instead of throwing.** Applied inside `parseDockerignore` (function line 209, target line 215). `504 / 503 pass / 1 fail / 0 skipped`. Red set (1):

1. `deploy-shape: the .dockerignore parser throws on forms it does not understand`

**M6 (criterion 8's falsifier, mine)** — see F-5. One red, at the negative control's own assertion.

## Criterion 2 — `ls-tree` line count

`git ls-tree <ref> -- <the 10 apps/chat paths>`, exit 0 both times: **10 lines on branch HEAD, 10 lines on master**. Five blobs (`.dockerignore`, `Dockerfile`, `compose.yaml`, `package.json`, `server.js`) and five trees (`bin`, `lib`, `public`, `test`, `watch`) — one line each, which is why a tree input costs the digest exactly one line.

## Criterion 9 — suite counts

**Host**, from the worktree, `node --test <abs>/.worktrees/AS-86/apps/chat/test/*.test.js`:

```
tests 504 / suites 0 / pass 504 / fail 0 / cancelled 0 / skipped 0 / todo 0 / duration_ms 7769.655375
```

Baseline was 498/498 `skipped 0`; **+6 exactly as predicted** (deploy-shape +3, watcher.test +1, deploy-inputs-git +2). Predicted 504 = observed 504.

**Compose (`--build`, with the `Image … Built` receipt line): PENDING THE ORCHESTRATOR.** Docker is off PATH for a sub-agent, so I did not attempt it; per CLAUDE.md the counted `--build` receipt is taken from the main checkout by absolute docker path. Expect **504 total, skipped 3**, not 2 (F-2): the two `deploy-inputs-git` tests and the `deploy-shape` index guard all skip on "git not runnable here", and `node:24-slim` ships no git. `skipped 0` in the container would mean git *is* present there and is itself a finding; any other number means a skip predicate misfired.

## Merge-tick prediction (plan §5, restated)

Merging AS-86 causes **two rebuilds, not one**, once ever, and it is expected and self-healing — do not read it as a loop. (a) The running **pre-merge** watcher sees a new 9-path id anyway (the Dockerfile and `watch/` blobs changed) and rebuilds once, stamping the image with a 9-path id. (b) Its own source digest changed, so once current it exits 70 and launchd relaunches it on the new code. (c) The **new** watcher computes a **10-path** id, which cannot equal the stamped 9-path id, and rebuilds once more. ~1–2 min each. The merge report should predict the second rebuild in advance.

**Seam note for the AS-84 lane:** my only edit inside the deploy-ops block of `watcher.test.js` is the one-line log literal at line 1007 (`8 of 9` → `9 of 10`) — a mid-block edit, not a tail append, so it cannot collide with appends at the end of that block. `deployHarness` derives its fake `lsTree` from `IMAGE_INPUTS`, so the tenth entry flows into AS-84's tests automatically provided AS-84 does not hard-code 9.

## Acceptance sweep — a floor check, not the review (M5)

**11 of 11 criteria pass; the 5 findings above sit *outside* this list, two of them corrections to the criteria themselves.**

1. **PASS** — `IMAGE_INPUTS` has 10 entries including `'.dockerignore'`; the Dockerfile COPYs it on the manifest line; the self-exclusion is gone; the COPY-set guard literals are 7 lines / 10 sources / 10 entries.
2. **PASS** — 10 `ls-tree` lines, verified by hand, above.
3. **PASS, with a wider red set than predicted** (8 vs 4). See F-1; every extra red is a real guard over the same fact.
4. **PASS** — red set exactly the two predicted.
5. **PASS** — red set exactly the one predicted, and the refusal reason is `inputs-missing` as stated.
6. **PASS** — red set exactly the one predicted.
7. **PASS** — six unrecognised forms examined (literal `6` asserted before the loop): negation, star glob, question glob, bracket glob, double-star glob, leading-slash anchor; plus a positive parse so the throws discriminate. The real file parses to exactly 3 patterns (`data`, `README.md`, `chat`), asserted in the manifest test rather than the parser test so M4 stays a single red. Guard falsified by M7.
8. **PASS** — negative control present and green. Cardinality before quantification: **10 stubbed inputs** (5 files, 5 directories stubbed one file deep; directory-ness read from the real `apps/chat` rather than hard-coded), plus `README.md`; **3 commits** in test 1, **2 commits** in test 2; tracked count asserted at 12 in test 2. Falsified by M6 (F-5).
9. **HOST PASS** 504/504 `skipped 0`. Compose pending the orchestrator, with the expected number and its reason stated above.
10. **PASS** — this comment, in the required order.
11. **PASS** — `git diff master...branch` on `advance-watcher.mjs` is exactly two hunks, at the `IMAGE_INPUTS` comment block and the new exports directly beneath it; zero changed lines mention `computeDesired`, `decideDeploy`, `parseLsTree`, `evaluate` or `shutdown`. The seam guarantee to AS-84/AS-87 holds.

**Deviations from the plan:** none in approach or scope. The only unplanned edits are the five hard-coded input counts in `watcher.test.js` that §4 did not enumerate (F-1) — required, not discretionary: the suite is red without them.

Orchestrator note (Owen, tick watcher:93997 loop tick 23): the criterion-9 compose --build receipt was not taken this tick (the three lanes used the tick budget; 25 min elapsed at handoff). The review stage owns it: Priya runs it from the main checkout by absolute docker path (/usr/local/bin/docker, node -e + spawnSync, -p as86rev) and quotes the Image ... Built line; expect skipped 3 per Lena's finding 2, not the plan's 2. Reviewer: do not read Lena's scratchpad or any Lattice auto-review before forming your own results.

data.body:
REVIEW (qa-priya, cold, tick watcher:93997 loop tick 24). Inputs: plan, git diff master...feat/AS-86-dockerignore-image-input (735b050, b4d3455; 7 files +445/-20), worktree .worktrees/AS-86. Auto-review daemon flag ignored (not the gate); implementer report read only after my cold pass. Logs: scratchpad/agent-qa-priya/AS-86/.

FINDINGS FIRST (6; 0 blocking):
F1 (non-blocking, backlog-worthy) parseDockerignore accepts three forms Docker normalises and this parser does not: './lib' -> pattern './lib', 'lib/../lib' -> 'lib/../lib', '.' -> '.'. BuildKit Cleans each (to lib, lib, everything), so an ignore line './lib' would shrink the lib COPY while the 'hides no input' loop compares './lib' !== 'lib' and stays green. The parser's stated contract is 'every form we have not needed THROWS'; these three do not. 17 forms probed in parser-probe.mjs (scratch copy of the function): 7 refused correctly, 10 accepted, 3 of those wrongly. Not a criterion (§6.7 names 6 forms, all verified); since AS-86 the digest moves on any commit to the file, so the hazard is a guard blind spot, not a silent deploy. One-line refusal for './', '..' segments and '.' — behavioural, so not fixed inline. Recommend a rider on AS-87 or a small backlog task.
F2 (plan-prediction deviation, verified independently) M1 red set is 8, not the plan's 4. The 4 extras: 'AS-75 parseLsTree' (literal 10), 'AS-86 classifyImagePaths' (fixture .dockerignore becomes unclassified), 'AS-75 makeDeployOps: a dirty image-input tree refuses' (regex '9 of 10'), 'AS-86 deploy-inputs-git: stray compose.override.yaml' (scratchRepo asserts IMAGE_INPUTS.length === 10). All four are cardinality pins moved 9->10 in this diff; wider by construction, none vacuous. Matches the implementer's claim; I did not take it on faith.
F3 (plan-prediction deviation) compose skipped is 3, not the §6-preamble's 2: the two deploy-inputs-git tests plus 'deploy-shape: every tracked path under apps/chat is an image input or declared not one' (which §3.2 itself says skips without git). All three skip on the same 'git not runnable' predicate; counted, named.
F4 (known, not new) advance-watcher.mjs:405 comment still reads 'over 8 of 9 inputs' (implementer cited :358; it is 405 on this branch). Criterion 11 forbids touching that region; rides AS-87. Nothing else stale: watch/README.md updated (ten inputs, 9 of 10 row); apps/chat/README.md, Dockerfile, compose.yaml grep clean.
F5 (non-blocking, backlog) NOT_IMAGE_INPUTS is a second literal list; drift is guarded in the dangerous direction (an undeclared tracked path fails) but not the harmless one (a root that no longer exists, e.g. README.md deleted, stays as a stale literal). Acceptable; note for whoever touches it.
F6 (nits, no action) plan §3.3 says trailing '/' is 'stripped and recorded' — implementation strips only; nothing depends on the record. §3.4 fetchJson returns null instead of {build:{id:A}}; computeDesired never calls it.

ACCEPTANCE SWEEP (floor check; 11 criteria, 11 pass):
AC1 pass: IMAGE_INPUTS 10 entries incl '.dockerignore'; Dockerfile 'COPY compose.yaml Dockerfile .dockerignore ./'; .dockerignore self-exclusion line removed (master copy shown for contrast); guard literals 7/10/10.
AC2 pass: git ls-tree HEAD -- <10 paths> on the branch = 10 lines (6 blobs, 4 trees), observed.
AC3 M1 (remove '.dockerignore' from the frozen array; diff showed exactly '-  '.dockerignore',', entries counted 9): 504 run, fail 8 — the plan's 4 (COPY-set guard, '.dockerignore is an image input and hides no manifest', 'every tracked path...', 'a committed change to .dockerignore changes the desired id') plus the 4 in F2. Restored, git diff --exit-code 0.
AC4 M2 (inside classifyImagePaths body, 'else unclassified.push(p)' -> 'else declared.push(p)'; diff at that line only): fail 2 — 'AS-86 classifyImagePaths...' and 'deploy-inputs-git: stray compose.override.yaml...'. Exact. Restored, clean.
AC5 M3 (makeDeployOps 'const paths = IMAGE_INPUTS.slice(0, 9).map(...)'; diff at that line only): fail 1 — 'deploy-inputs-git: a committed change to .dockerignore changes the desired id' (inputs-missing refusal at step 2, the AS-75 cardinality guard catching it). Exact. Restored, clean.
AC6 M4 (.dockerignore in place, '+test/fixtures' after 'chat'): fail 1 — 'deploy-shape: .dockerignore is an image input and hides no manifest'. Exact. Restored, clean.
AC7 pass: 6 unrecognised forms throw (asserted count 6); real file parses to exactly ['data','README.md','chat'].
AC8 pass: negative control present (README-only commit leaves id == B); cardinality 10 stubbed inputs (dir/file mix asserted), 3 commits, then the pass.
AC9 pass: HOST 34 test files, 504 tests / 504 pass / 0 fail / 0 skipped, exit 0 (host-run.log). COMPOSE -p asc-review-as86 run --rm --build test, DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1: receipt line ' Image asc-review-as86-test Built '; 504 tests / 501 pass / 0 fail / 3 skipped (named in F3, git absent in node:24-slim) / 47.8 s, exit 0 (compose.log). Project torn down: network asc-review-as86_default removed.
AC10 pass: implementer report carries M1-M4 red sets, ls-tree 10, both counts (compose deferred to review — taken here), §5 double-rebuild restated.
AC11 pass: diff of advance-watcher.mjs touches only the IMAGE_INPUTS comment block, the 10th entry, and the new NOT_IMAGE_INPUTS/classifyImagePaths directly beneath; computeDesired/decideDeploy/parseLsTree/evaluate/shutdown untouched.
Mutants: 4 run, 4 killed, 0 survived. Worktree clean after each (git diff --exit-code 0) and at end.

M6 PROBES past the list: (a) parser edge forms — F1; CRLF, trailing/double slash, leading whitespace, comment-only and empty file all handled. (b) git absent: all three git-backed tests skip as counted outcomes (compose log names each with the reason) — no silent pass. (c) id churn: desired id is over ls-tree blob/tree hashes, not the build context, so COPYing .dockerignore cannot churn it; compose build cache keys on file content only. (d) task's own acceptance ('commit a change to .dockerignore, observe the predicate go dirty') observed via the scratch-repo test on real git: A != B and decideDeploy -> {deploy, stale-build}, and again under M3 where the same test is the one that goes red. (e) NOT_IMAGE_INPUTS drift — F5. (f) Dockerfile.dockerignore name-boundary case covered by the fixture.

SEAM for AS-84's rebase (its branch: watcher.test.js +252, advance-watcher.mjs +286 vs master): AS-86 edits watcher.test.js:1045 ('/9 of 10 image inputs/' inside 'AS-75 makeDeployOps: a dirty image-input tree refuses') and the parseLsTree literals at :448/454/464 — both in or adjacent to the deploy-ops block AS-84 extends. AS-84 must carry 10 there and must not re-introduce 9; the test insertion at :670 is mid-file, so EOF appends will not collide. Merge order AS-85 -> AS-86 -> AS-84 stands.

Inline fixes: none. Merge-tick note: expect the §5 double rebuild (9-path id, then 10-path id), once.
